task.title: Complete shared visual variables and native UI wrappers
task.input: The eight core visual-base variables and the complete component/state specification in section 11
task.output: visual-components; the complete single token source and native Button/Input/Dialog/Status wrappers
task.accept: 1) Extend only the same tokens.css, without a second set of color/font/spacing variables. Button/Input/Dialog/Status must use section 11 heights, 2px borders, 0 border radius and disabled/busy/error/focus values; Class/variable-reference and native-semantics assertions must match every state; M1-T4 verifies actual computed styles in integration. 2) Wrapper components contain no fetch, Prisma, identity, cookie or business-role decisions. Automated tests cover keyboard focus and dialog focus restoration; public and admin clients import the same export.
